In the scene fields, describe in your own plain words only the physical effects the text names, such as smoke, cloud, fire, storm, wind or light filling a place, spread through the scene or coming from beyond the frame rather than gathered into one glowing shape. Never name it or call it seated, standing, enthroned or riding, and leave out its throne, seat, chariot, robe, train or hem and any face, hands, hair or body: bodily words in the text are metaphors. Say only where those effects are. Whenever the scene keeps light, cloud or fire that comes from it, select it. Keep the people and the place as the subject of the image. A command, oath or mention alone is not an appearance, so add no effect for it then.
effects.planField: For a cast entry with hasForm false, describe only the smoke, cloud, fire, wind or light the text names, never the entry itself.
effects.reviewFault: a hasForm false entry is given a body, face, hands, clothing, a robe or train, a silhouette, a throne or seat of its own, or is described as seated or standing.

checkFigure.direct: true if any face, head, hands, robe, body or human-shaped silhouette appears inside, made of or emerging from light, radiance, cloud, smoke, fire, a pillar or the sky, or seated or standing on a throne, unless it is clearly one of the beings the description names. Look closely at every bright area, cloud and throne; a faint, translucent or partial figure counts. People standing in the scene, and winged angels or creatures the description names, do not count.
checkFigure.describe: true if a head, face, hands, shoulders or a robed or human-shaped body appears inside, made of or emerging from light, radiance, cloud, smoke, fire, a pillar or the sky, or seated or standing on a throne, unless it is clearly one of the beings the description names. A faint or translucent figure counts if you can point to its head, face, hands or body outline. A flame, a heart-shaped glow or billowing cloud is not a figure. People standing in the scene, and winged angels or creatures the description names, do not count.
checkFigure.brightAreas: What is inside each bright area, cloud, fire, pillar or throne, or "none".

symbol.renderBlock: SYMBOLIC FORM (binding): each of these appears only in the non-human form its canon describes, never as a person, a human-like figure, a face or a robed body:
symbol.planSystem: - Cast marked "shown only as its canon form" are never drawn as a person. When one of them appears or acts in the moment, select it and describe it in that form, placed in the scene with its own pose. Never give it a human face, hands, clothing or body, even when the text calls it a man, a woman or a speaker: those words name it, they do not describe its look. If the moment only mentions it, leave it out.
